verdicts.title: The product on smooth and generalized valuations
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The product of smooth valuations on manifolds is described in terms of differential forms, Gelfand transforms and blow-up spaces. It is shown that the product extends partially to generalized valuations and corresponds geometrically to transversal intersections. This result is used to prove a general kinematic formula on compact rank one symmetric spaces.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes products of smooth/generalized valuations on manifolds via differential forms and kinematic formulas on symmetric spaces, which shares only the word 'valuation' with the conjecture and does not address quadratic form rank, Boolean matrices, or communication complexity.

verdicts.title: Product numerical range in a space with tensor product structure
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study operators acting on a tensor product Hilbert space and investigate their product numerical range, product numerical radius and separable numerical range. Concrete bounds for the product numerical range for Hermitian operators are derived. verdicts.title: Contravariant Form on Tensor Product of Highest Weight Modules
